name: Chili Con Queso (Nacho Cheese Dip)
description: A warm, cheesy dip made with cream cheese, cheddar cheese soup, and processed cheese, perfect for tortilla chips.
recipeIngredient: 10 oz can (284 mL) cheddar cheese soup

recipeInstructions.text: Let the cream cheese stand at room temperature to warm up.
In a saucepan, melt the cream cheese over heat.
Add the cheddar cheese soup, stirring constantly until well combined.
Crumble the processed cheese into smaller pieces and melt it into the cheese mixture.
Add salsa to taste, adjusting the amount based on the type of salsa used.
Serve the Chili Con Queso hot with tortilla chips as a dip, or cold with tacos or chili.

keywords: nacho cheese dip, chili con queso, cheesy dip, tortilla chip dip

_similar.name: Hot Cheese Dip
_similar.description: A creamy bacon and cheddar dip baked inside a pumpernickel bread shell.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the top off the pumpernickel loaf and hollow it out, leaving a thick shell.
Mix the cream cheese, mayonnaise, cheddar cheese, and bacon bits until well combined.
Spoon the mixture into the hollowed-out bread.
Wrap the loaf in tinfoil, leaving the hole with the cheese mixture uncovered.
Bake at 325°F for 1½ hours.
Serve hot with the bread pieces.

_similar.keywords: pumpernickel dip, hot bacon dip, cheddar dip

_similar.name: Quick Garlic Fingers
_similar.description: A simple and flavorful appetizer featuring garlic-infused margarine on flatbread topped with a blend of cheddar, mozzarella, and Monterey Jack cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the margarine, garlic salt, oregano, basil, and thyme together until well combined.
Spread this mixture evenly on the cheese flat bread.
Sprinkle the grated cheddar, mozzarella, and Monterey Jack cheese over the top.
Place in a preheated oven at 350°F for approximately 10 to 15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the edges are slightly golden and crusty if desired.

_similar.keywords: garlic fingers, cheesy bread, quick appetizer

_similar.name: Surprise Spread
_similar.description: A layered seafood dip with shrimp, cocktail sauce, and cheese.
recipeIngredient: 3 (4 oz) cans small shrimp, rinsed and drained
Tortilla chips or assorted crackers for serving

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the cream cheese, sour cream, and mayonnaise together until smooth.
Spread this mixture in the bottom of a deep pie plate, pizza pan, or shallow baking dish.
Scatter the shrimp over the top.
Cover with the seafood cocktail sauce.
Add layers of mozzarella cheese, green pepper, and green onions.
Top with diced tomatoes if desired.
Chill until ready to serve with tortilla chips or crackers.

_similar.keywords: layered shrimp dip, seafood spread, party dip
